title: enchanted apples+
description: Apples+ is a Forge 1.20.1 mod that adds new Apple Enchanting Books and upgraded enchanted golden apples with multiple tiers. It gives players a progression system for crafting stronger and more powerful apple-based items in survival.
body: Apples+ adds a new apple progression to Minecraft with stronger enchanted apples and special Apple Enchanting Books. Start by crafting the first apple book, then upgrade your way through multiple levels to unlock stronger and more powerful enchanted golden apples. The mod adds new crafting recipes, custom apple items, and higher-tier enchanted apple variants for players who want even more overpowered food in survival. Built for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1.
